transcript.text: Hello, this is the scheduling assistant for Riverside Family Clinic. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'd like to see Dr. Smith.
Of course. May I have your full name and date of birth?
Noah Lindqvist. February second, nineteen ninety.
Thanks, Noah. Are you a new or an existing patient?
Dr. Smith has Monday at 10 AM or Wednesday at 2 PM.
Booked: Noah Lindqvist, Monday at 10 AM. A confirmation will be sent. Thank you for calling, goodbye.
